subject: Pipeline sizing workshop: OrbitAI committed-capacity ask
body:
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Chambers <alan.chambers@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline sizing workshop: OrbitAI committed-capacity ask

Team — looping infra/finance into OrbitAI’s committed capacity request so we can size a Dedicated pool and confirm commercial terms. Attached: pipeline snapshot and OrbitAI’s usage estimate.

Quick context: OrbitAI indicated in last call they expect steady production traffic that would benefit from a reserved pool beginning Aug 1st. They’re asking for a 3-month commit with an option to scale up in month 2. High level asks from the prospect: 8 reserved GPUs steady, burst to 12 during model training windows.

Agenda for Friday’s 11:00 workshop:
- Confirm minimum deliverable (start date, committed GPU count)
- Infra constraints: availability and lead time to guarantee smallest-latency placement
- Finance: pricing cadence, discounts for short-term ramp, and draft SOW language
- Sales: mutual action plan + procurement milestones

Immediate asks: Jordan — can you bring a short runbook for how we’d isolate 8 GPUs for a new Dedicated tenant (latency estimate + earliest guaranteed availability)?
Laura — rough $/month for 8 GPU reserved (with burst credits to 12) so we can include in the doc for Alan today.
Ben — I’ll own the MAP and follow up with OrbitAI procurement after we confirm numbers.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 2026-06-03_pipeline_snapshot.csv (csv)
- OrbitAI_Monthly_usage_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)

---
From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Chambers <alan.chambers@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline sizing workshop: OrbitAI committed-capacity ask

Tessa — quick infra notes ahead of the workshop:
- We can standby-reserve 8 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west2 starting Aug 1 with a 2-week provisioning buffer to validate networking and NVLink topology. If customer needs earlier start, we can place them on shared hosts with soft isolation (slightly higher p99 latency).
- Burst model (12 GPUs) feasible via burst credits across the pool; sustained >12 will require additional slot reservations or autoscale policy changes.
- Latency estimate for 8-GPU Dedicated tenant (p50/p95/p99): 28ms / 46ms / 82ms (text-generation, seq len 512) when colocated with model cache enabled.

Risks / asks:
1) If OrbitAI requires guaranteed p99 < 60ms during training bursts, we’ll need to reserve 12 GPUs or apply region fallback rules.
2) We need procurement lead time to complete networking & KMS exchange (estimate 10 business days).

I’ll bring a 1-slide availability map and a short runbook Friday.

—Jordan
Sr Infrastructure PM

---
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Chambers <alan.chambers@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline sizing workshop: OrbitAI committed-capacity ask

Thanks — preliminary commercial math below (ballpark to use in MAP):
- Base: 8 reserved A100-eq GPUs = $112,000 / month (list), applying standard PLG discount matrix we can offer 18% to start => $91,840 / month.
- Burst credits (allowing spikes to 12 GPUs up to 500 GPU-hours/month): add-on at $12,000 / month.
- Commitment term: 3 months initial; propose opt-in scale in month 2 with price re-eval only for incremental capacity.

Proposed structure for the MAP doc:
1) Start date: Aug 1 (subject to KMS & network exchange)
2) Committed capacity: 8 GPUs reserved, burst to 12 (policy-based, not hard reservation)
3) Billing: monthly in arrears; up-front invoice for setup if OrbitAI requests dedicated colo network config
4) Early-exit: 30% buyout if cancelled within first 30 days after start

Alan — if this aligns with your expectations I’ll draft the commercial paragraph and include a sample invoice.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Finance

---
From: Alan Chambers <alan.chambers@orbitai.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline sizing workshop: OrbitAI committed-capacity ask

Tessa / team — thanks for the clear breakdown. OrbitAI is aligned with the ask but a couple items to confirm before Friday:
- Start date: Aug 1 works for us, but we’ll need the KMS exchange details and a short security questionnaire answered before legal routes the PO.
- Capacity: we’d like to firm 8 reserved GPUs with the option to convert burst credits to hard reservations after month 1 if utilization exceeds 65% for two consecutive weeks.
- Pricing: the numbers look reasonable; procurement will confirm via email. Expect a PO request by next Wed if the MAP looks close to final.

Alan Chambers
VP, ML Engineering
OrbitAI
alan.chambers@orbitai.com
